basic_info.description: Pacific Heights living at it's finest! This elegantly designed condominium residence features a grand foyer, formal dining room, spacious family room with hardwood flooring, custom plantation shutters, a terrace with south facing sun exposure, hardwood floors, abundant in-unit storage, plus a separate storage locker, 1 car garaged/assigned parking space, 24/7 doorperson, a rooftop swimming pool and more.   This meticulously maintained residence offers turnkey luxury living in the heart of Pacific Heights. This is a "Must See" property for anyone looking for a full time residence or a 2nd home.
